about: The parity contract for the workflow DSL (#133): one case per rule, and the verdict
every validator of this language has to produce for it.
ouroboros-rest asserts against this file from its zod validator's suite and
ouroboros-engine from its pydantic validator's, each reading this directory directly.
That is what makes the two agree without either module importing the other: a rule
added to one and forgotten in the other is a failure in the half that was forgotten.
A diagnostic is recorded as its `code`, the RFC 6901 `path` it is anchored at, and the
node id or edge endpoints it names. Its message is not: each validator renders its own
prose, and a contract over English sentences is one nobody can translate. Errors and
warnings are in document order -- by path, with numeric path segments compared as
`catalogue` is decision P7's vocabulary. A case that names none supplies none, which is
the honest answer to *is this reference known?* when nothing in the system knows.
Regenerating this file is not how it is maintained. It is reviewed and frozen; a change
to it is a change to the contract, and both suites have to be green on the new one.

cases.name: standard-fix
cases.about: Mockup 04's graph, complete: five node types, three edge kinds, and the loop.

cases.name: standard-fix-known-references
cases.about: The same graph against a catalogue that lists every skill, model and task it names.

cases.name: standard-fix-unknown-references
cases.about: Decision P7: against an empty catalogue every reference warns and the document still saves.

cases.name: minimal
cases.about: The smallest workflow there is: a trigger, a terminal, and the edge between them.

cases.name: infra-bare
cases.about: An infra stage with neither a pool nor a command, which the issue specifies as legal.

cases.name: predicate-kinds
cases.about: Every predicate kind and every terminal action, on branch edges out of one decision.

cases.name: document-not-object
cases.about: A JSON array is not a workflow, and the validator says so rather than throwing.

cases.name: dsl-version-unknown
cases.about: A document written in a later language: reported as such, and no rule is asserted about it.

cases.name: nodes-empty
cases.about: A workflow with no stages at all.

cases.name: trigger-unknown-event
cases.about: An event outside decision P8's vocabulary.

cases.name: node-bad-id
cases.about: A node id that is not a slug.

cases.name: node-unknown-type
cases.about: A sixth node type, which the canvas could not draw and the interpreter could not run.

cases.name: node-title-wrong-type
cases.about: A value of the wrong JSON type, which is a different answer from an absent one.

cases.name: node-missing-position
cases.about: A node with no place on the canvas.

cases.name: node-unknown-property
cases.about: Every object in the DSL is closed; an undeclared property is named, not dropped.

cases.name: trigger-node-with-config
cases.about: The trigger node configures nothing: its predicate is the document's own trigger.

cases.name: llm-skill-mode-without-skill
cases.about: Skill mode with no skill to load.

cases.name: llm-skill-in-prompt-mode
cases.about: A skill in direct-prompt mode would never be loaded.

cases.name: llm-routing-ambiguous
cases.about: The inspector's two routing radios are exclusive; both set is neither answered.

cases.name: llm-routing-missing
cases.about: Routing that neither inherits a task's route nor pins a model.

cases.name: llm-limits-out-of-range
cases.about: A retry budget outside the bounds the schema publishes.

cases.name: llm-permissions-missing
cases.about: Decision P9: both permissions are required, because one nobody decided binds nobody.

cases.name: flow-predicate-unknown-kind
cases.about: A predicate kind outside the closed grammar.

cases.name: predicate-extra-property
cases.about: A predicate carrying a member its own kind does not declare.

cases.name: term-unknown-action
cases.about: A terminal action outside the three the issue specifies.

cases.name: term-options-mismatch
cases.about: Auto-merge with no options: the chip says squash and delete branch, so the document must.

cases.name: node-duplicate-id
cases.about: Two nodes sharing an id — schema-valid, and the first rule JSON Schema cannot express.

cases.name: no-trigger
cases.about: Nothing starts a run.

cases.name: two-triggers
cases.about: Two things start a run, and a run pins one version of one graph.

cases.name: no-terminal
cases.about: No path through the graph ends.

cases.name: unreachable-node
cases.about: A second component the trigger cannot reach.

cases.name: edge-unknown-from
cases.about: An edge leaving a stage that does not exist.

cases.name: edge-unknown-to
cases.about: An edge arriving at a stage that does not exist.

cases.name: edge-duplicate
cases.about: A second edge between a pair already joined: an edge is identified by its endpoints.

cases.name: edge-self-reference
cases.about: An edge from a stage to itself.

cases.name: edge-into-trigger
cases.about: An edge back into the trigger, which is where a run starts.

cases.name: edge-out-of-terminal
cases.about: An edge out of a terminal, which is where a run ends.

cases.name: edge-branch-without-condition
cases.about: A branch nothing decides.

cases.name: edge-default-with-condition
cases.about: A condition on an edge that is always taken.

cases.name: edge-loop-not-upstream
cases.about: The ouroboros rule: a loop edge goes back up the graph, and this one goes forward.
